speaker: Doctor
text: I have noted your history of sudden-onset lower abdominal pain. To better understand your condition, could you tell me if the pain is localized to the right lower quadrant or if it radiates to your groin?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old male. The patient reports the sudden onset of abdominal pain while playing football two hours ago. He has a past medical history significant only for asthma. Additionally, his social history is notable for unprotected sex with four partners in the past month.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the history. Given your unprotected sex with multiple partners and the sudden onset of pain, could you tell me if the pain is sharp, and whether you have noticed any burning sensation when urinating or a discharge from your penis?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine culture, and STI panel (Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, Syphilis, HIV).
REQUEST IMAGES: Scrotal_Ultrasound.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Epididymitis (considering age and risk factors) or Testicular Torsion (if pain is severe and nausea/vomiting is present).
